utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and spare parts all morning. If you need the details, I can go ask around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that right? Can you confirm exactly what’s been collected so far?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check on that for you, but I don’t have the exact list yet. I’ll ask around and let you know what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to help out with the repair drive and spread the word to the neighbors. Let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Vik — I might need a hand figuring out what still needs fixing. I’ve been a bit scattered, so I’ll let you know when I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll help spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a drill, some screws, and maybe a ladder if you have one? If you’re free, it’d also help a lot to sort tools and hand things out as we work.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a drill, screws, and a ladder if I can find one. I can also sort tools and hand things out while we work.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly tape, screws, and a few spare lightbulbs would help a lot. If you can grab any of those, I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring tape and a box of screws, and I’ll see if I have any spare lightbulbs too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time window works best for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Faye — could we aim for early Saturday morning, maybe 9 to 11? I think that window should work well for most folks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 9 to 11 on Saturday should work well for me — I’ll help spread the word around the school crowd.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Oren. Let’s keep it simple—tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll write down a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli. I think it’s the loose fence, the porch step, and maybe that leaky gutter—I’m a bit fuzzy, but that’s what I remember.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good start. I’ll write those three down, and we can check them one by one so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Pia—there’s a repair drive happening soon, and I’m telling neighbors fast. Want me to send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send them over—I just want to make sure I’ve got the time and place सही.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the time and place right over, so you’ve got it handy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest yet — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s moving along nicely — we’ve got a few volunteers lined up and I’m sorting the last details now. I’ll share the full update as soon as everything’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear — thanks for keeping me in the loop. I’ll wait for the full update when you’ve got everything confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details one more time so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll send the repair drive details again so you have everything in one place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’m ready for the details whenever you send them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it quiet for now. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — just point me to the biggest gap, and I’ll slip in when it’s quiet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The back fence is the biggest gap, near the alley. If you come by after dusk, I can show you where to start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got some tools I can lend for the repair drive. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could I borrow a hammer and a screwdriver set?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can lend you a hammer and a screwdriver set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m tracking the repair drive locations now—tell me which stop you need, and I’ll point you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I just need the closest stop with tools—can you point me to that one?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The closest stop with tools is the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd. If you head there now, that should be the quickest one.
